Team —

We're in the final pull on Q4 before the QBR packet is frozen next Wednesday. Attached is the Q4_OKR_LEDGER_v3.xlsx; I pre-filled the measurable columns where we have explicit counts and left notes for open items. Please do the following by COB Monday (Nov 30):

- Update the % complete in column F for your areas and add a 1–2 sentence narrative for any KRs scoring <60%.
- Add any supporting evidence links directly in column I (dashboards, PRs, eval runs).
- If you propose a different score than the rubric suggests, add a short justification in column J.

Two follow-ups from me:
1) Marcus — can you drop a team-level heatmap (risk/impact) into the ledger for the ops & runtime teams?
2) Vivek — I’ve cc'd Ella from QBR consulting; please confirm whether we need an alternate framing for the product metrics section.

Goal: I want a consolidated ledger and a one-page executive narrative draft in the drive by Tuesday morning so I can finalize the QBR exec one-pager for leadership review.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q4_OKR_LEDGER_v3.xlsx, QBR_exec-one-pager_draft.pdf

Vanessa —

Thanks, pulling this together now. Quick notes:
- I updated Sales Enablement KR-2 to 78% and added the enablement playbook link in column I.
- For KR-5 (enterprise renewals), I attached the topline renewal health table to the ledger and left a short justification in column J; the main driver for the lower score is one strategic account pushing renewal to Feb.
- Narrative for low-scoring KRs added for Sales Ops and Enablement.

I'm attaching a one-paragraph blurb for the exec one-pager that focuses on retention risk and mitigation (see below). If helpful, I can reword to emphasize cost-per-acquisition improvements instead.

--- blurb (for copy/paste) ---
Renewals remain the primary near-term revenue risk. One strategic enterprise customer has delayed signature into FY27; we are offsetting this with an accelerated mid-market expansion and targeted success plays that have improved retention velocity in comparable cohorts. Full mitigation plan and expected timing are in the ledger.
--- end blurb ---

Laura
VP, GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Adding my edits —

- Product metrics: I think we should reframe the product reliability section to focus on SLO attainment and customer impact rather than raw incident count. Ella (cc) agreed the exec audience responds better to impact framing.
- Scoring tweak: I accepted Laura's suggested 78% for Enablement KR-2 and aligned Runtime KR-3 to Marcus's note; moved a supporting sentence into column I.
- I've also added a one-line leadership ask we should include on the one-pager: request for approval to hire 2 infra SREs in Q1 to address the model-swap scaling gap.

Deadline reminder: Vanessa, do you want me to assemble the combined exec one-pager directly from the ledger or would you prefer a separate doc that mirrors the deck? If separate, I can produce a condensed narrative by EOD today.

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Quick decisions and next steps:

1) I'll synthesize the ledger into the exec one-pager using the blurb Laura provided and the impact framing Vivek recommended.
2) We'll call out the model-swap as a tactical win with a Q1 hiring ask for 2 infra SREs (Vivek, please send the proposed JD and 90-day onboarding plan by EOD Thursday).
3) Marcus — please add a 1-sentence cost/benefit line to the ledger that quantifies the token-cost delta you mentioned.
4) Laura — please review the retention language tonight; if you approve, I'll fold it into slide 2 of the deck.

I'll share the consolidated one-pager draft to the Drive link at 5pm PT today for comments. Ella, Sarah — adding you to keep you sighted on the executive asks; no action needed unless you have objections to framing.

Final note: if any of you cannot meet the Monday deadline that was in my original ask, let me know now so I can reassign.

Thanks —
